TKK Symphony Acquisition Corporation Announces Further Extension of Expiration Date of Tender Offer for its Ordinary Shares December 16, 2019 — TKK Symphony Acquisition Corporation (Nasdaq: TKKS) ("TKK" or the "Company") today announced that it has further extended the expiration date of its previously announced tender offer to purchase up to 25,000,000 ordinary shares at a purchase price of $10.28 per share in cash. As amended, the tender offer will now expire at 5:00 pm New York City time, on Wednesday, January 8, 2020, unless further extended or earlier terminated.
